title: Magnus Carlsen's Mind-Blowing Memory! World Chess Champion tested
summary: Grandmaster David Howell tests Magnus Carlsen by showing him chess positions and asking which famous games they come from. Carlsen recognizes many almost instantly.
why: HN commenters cite it as an example of expert memory built on context, such as Carlsen identifying players, tournaments and moves from positions.

quote.text: They put a number of mid-game positions on the board, and Magnus was able to guess the players, tournament, game number, who won
